name: The Slow Sunday
description: A considered trio of a bath soak concept, a body cream concept and a little candle. An invitation to leave the afternoon unplanned.
story: For the one who is always looking after everyone else. Three little rituals, gathered together for an afternoon with nothing on the calendar.
contents: A tall jar of imagined rose-toned bath salts.
A cream jar for the everyday care ritual.
The final note in a slower Sunday.

target.size: Bath soak 250 g + body cream 200 mL + candle 90 g
target.pack: Cream presentation box; berry ribbon; fitted recyclable-paper insert. Compare lift-off and hinged stock box structures.
target.note: The bath soak, cream and candle must be quoted as three separate components. Test the complete parcel for leakage, glass breakage and heat exposure.

presentation: A cream presentation box, a deep berry ribbon and a considered place for each of the three rituals. A soft, understated opening moment.

name: The Little Thank You
description: A hand cream and fragrance miniature concept, paired in a keepsake-style box. For the person who made your day a little easier.
story: For lending an ear. For opening their home. For being there. A modest gesture with room for a very specific thank you.
contents: An ivory tube, made to feel like an everyday companion.
A little bottle for a new scent story.

target.size: Hand cream 50 mL + fragrance miniature 10 mL
target.pack: Compact cream box; tube and travel-size fragrance in separate fitted compartments.
target.note: Confirm fragrance transport eligibility separately. Prioritize existing tube and vial tooling; no gift-note fulfillment assumed.

presentation: A small cream box holds two little gestures together. A berry accent and simple paper details give this thank-you its finishing touch.

name: The Evening Edit
description: An imagined collection of body oil, a candle and a fragrance miniature, brought together for a quiet evening.
story: When the day becomes an evening. A trio imagined around amber glass, soft light and the pleasure of having nowhere else to be.
contents: An amber dropper bottle for a care ritual.
A small cream vessel for the bedside scene.
A final little accent, tucked inside.

target.size: Body oil 100 mL + candle 90 g + fragrance miniature 10 mL
target.pack: Berry presentation box with dividers suitable for oil bottle, candle and miniature.
target.note: Confirm the correct oil closure and fragrance format before sampling. Quote component compatibility and liquid-safe transport packaging.

presentation: A deep berry box brings warm amber tones into one evening-inspired arrangement, with a separate place for each imagined ritual.

name: Fig & Paper
description: A fragrance concept inspired by an open notebook beside a fig tree. The scent direction is an editorial idea, not a verified formula.
story: An open notebook. A fig tree at the window. A room that is entirely your own. Fig & Paper imagines a green, quietly woody fragrance with a softer side.
contents: The rounded softness of ripe fig.

target.pack: Olive-toned rectangular glass bottle, dark cap, small cream label; explore existing bottle molds.
target.note: Compare glass coating, cap fit and atomizer compatibility. The green fig / pale wood direction is a creative brief, not a finished formula.

presentation: Olive-toned glass, a dark cap and a quiet cream label. The design pairs the feeling of green fig with the simplicity of an open notebook.

name: Amber Hour
tag: The golden part of the day
description: A warm fragrance concept inspired by late light on amber glass. An imagined scent story for the moments between plans.
occasion: For the warmest person you know
story: The last light across a room, held for a little longer. An imagined warm fragrance for someone who makes every place feel welcoming.

target.pack: Amber-toned glass and a restrained cream label; warm metal or dark closure to be sampled.
target.note: Request bottle/closure swatches and fragrance-development options. No finalized formula, concentration or longevity claim.

presentation: Warm amber glass and a simple label reflect the golden-hour mood. A restrained silhouette keeps the focus on the warmth of the color.

name: Petal Study
description: An airy floral fragrance concept that imagines a vase of loose garden stems. Artwork and description are for demonstration.
story: Loose stems in a favorite vase. The window open just a little. A floral fragrance idea for beginnings that deserve a softer sort of celebration.

target.pack: Soft rose-toned bottle study, pale label and understated closure.
target.note: Confirm repeatable glass color and print finish. Floral scent direction is subject to perfumer development and evaluation.

presentation: Soft rose-toned glass and a pale label give this fragrance concept a gentle, light-filled character.

name: Cloud Body Cream
description: A body cream concept in a generous cream-colored jar. Designed as a visual study of a simple daily care ritual; no efficacy claims.
story: A small pause on the bathroom shelf. Cloud imagines an everyday body-care essential in a cream jar with a deep berry lid.
contents: A rounded cream jar and berry lid.
A fragrance to make the gesture personal.

target.pack: Cream jar, deep berry screw lid, understated front label; stock jar first.
target.note: Ask for compatibility, seal/liner and transit checks. Formula, instructions and any claims require supplier documentation and merchant approval.

presentation: A rounded cream jar and a deep berry lid create a soft contrast. The concept is designed to sit quietly among everyday rituals.

name: Rosewater Soak
description: A bath soak packaging concept inspired by rose-colored water and slow evenings. Ingredients and usage directions are not finalized.
occasion: For a night with no plans
story: Warm water, a book left open, and permission to take your time. A bath-soak concept imagined in rose tones and amber glass.
contents: A tall amber jar and pale cream cap.
Cloud Body Cream for a two-part care edit.

target.pack: Tall amber jar with pale cap; moisture barrier and induction/liner options to compare.
target.note: Confirm actual formula and net-weight fit; do not infer rose ingredients or suitability from the concept name.

presentation: A tall amber jar and pale cap frame the warm, textured bath-soak concept, with a small cream label for an understated finish.

name: Golden Body Oil
description: A body oil concept presented in amber glass. This is a design prototype, with no real formulation, safety assessment or product for sale.
story: A drop of golden light for the everyday shelf. A body-oil packaging concept that makes a simple care ritual feel considered.
contents: Amber glass with a berry-colored dropper.
A quiet care moment at the end of the day.
Amber Hour for a warm-toned duet.

target.pack: Amber bottle with berry-toned dropper; evaluate pump as an alternate only after design review.
target.note: Request oil/closure compatibility, leak testing and fill-volume confirmation. No efficacy or absorption claims are specified.

presentation: Golden tones, amber glass and a berry-colored closure give this body-oil concept a warm, considered silhouette.
